identification: Large Victorian/Edwardian carved shell cameo brooch (pale pink conch shell ground, white relief, classical head with crescent moon, so Diana/Artemis type), in a gold-coloured claw-and-bead rim mount with leaf-engraved edge. Catalogue: mount acid tests as 9ct. About 5.5 x 4 cm against the ruler (cm and feet scale), roughly 7-10 g all up. Appears sound, light wear to claws.

viewing_check: Look for 9ct/375 stamp on pin or back, weigh it, check cameo for cracks or chips (nose, hair crescent), clasp and hinge condition, back for shell vs coral.
